status: Bounded startup and same-install relaunch qualified in two predetermined ordinary native G2 sessions; broader startup reliability remains open

validation.startup_keyboard_and_input: No app input before startup observation finished; then guarded network navigation opens one LG keyboard in each session

observation_contract.native_startup: Focused visible Home readiness and a later fresh producer endpoint beyond eight seconds of native runtime; no input or editor during this interval
observation_contract.external_sampler: Starts before ordinary launch and persists the first completed LG Home read before launch; foreground and window GETs are sequential and bounded
observation_contract.clocks: Each external query has host monotonic start/finish bounds. Native artifact retrieval has separate host bounds; clocks and service queries are not atomic
observation_contract.window_roles: Exact application/window-type pairs for Luma CARD, LG Home CARD, LG screensaver SCREENSAVER and LG launch splash SPLASH; unrelated, unknown and malformed observations stop the profile
observation_contract.splash: Rejected during prelaunch admission. One first-session splash window was temporally correlated after ordinary launch began; the reply contains no target-app association metadata
observation_contract.storage: Private bounded JSON records are published atomically without clobbering existing files; samplers are joined before transport teardown

departures.first: With the LG editor owned, the guarded host launches LG Home through its ordinary application API. Native window_hidden exit closes its SDK session; all bound processes are absent and Home is quiet before relaunch
departures.second: Same installed app starts a new process and loads its saved preferences. Guarded network Back closes the LG keyboard, then ordinary Back navigation exits from Home

prior_attempt.reason: The strict initial sampler classified an exact LG splash window as unrelated and stopped after six records. The scenario rejected that partial observation
prior_attempt.native_evidence: The first producer was live-bound and reached a fresh focused Home endpoint beyond eight native seconds. No app navigation, text or keyboard input had begun
prior_attempt.change_for_v2: A separate versioned host sampler recognizes the exact splash window role and preserves prelaunch rejection and postlaunch time-only correlation. Native binary and frozen package are unchanged
prior_attempt.cause_limit: This was an observation-policy rejection; no application crash cause or splash target association is established

closeout.scope: Each completed test run at its closeout time

scope_limits: Two successful predetermined sessions do not establish general cold-entry reliability or explain the earlier startup focus-loss observation.
Fresh native endpoints establish survival to at least eight seconds of runtime, not uninterrupted focus or eight seconds after readiness.
LG splash observations have timing correlation only; no exclusive target-app association, guaranteed cadence or complete compositor coverage is claimed.
First departure is programmatic LG Home launch; second close and exit use guarded network Back. This profile does not qualify physical input or typing.
No broader dismissal-race, service-failure transition, performance, reboot persistence, full TV functionality or retained-update admission follows from this profile.
C2 has not run this startup/relaunch profile.
